narrative.headline: Top 50 tape is broadly risk-on with 35 of 50 names bullish or lean bullish, but semis are the standout defection led by NVDA.
bullish_setups: ABBV: perfect 10.0 composite — max flow score plus $1.02B dark pool print, textbook accumulation
XOM: 9.91 composite with $1.45M near-money call premium and $247M dark pool — energy majors being loaded
GOOG/GOOGL: both >9.3 with $9.3M/$16.3M call premium and $300M+/$390M+ dark pool prints — mega-cap tech leadership rotating here, not NVDA
AMZN: $20.3M call premium plus $471M dark pool, blocks at 10.0
LLY + MRK: pharma stacked bullish alongside ABBV — sector-wide institutional bid
ORCL: $1.03B dark pool print — largest single-name dark pool in the scan
PLTR: 9.02 composite with $15.9M call premium, rare non-mega-cap conviction
AAPL: $28.5M call premium and $832M dark pool — the largest flow tally in the book
bearish_setups: NVDA: 0.86 composite despite $10B-tier dark pool/blocks — flow is 1.43, put-heavy positioning against the tape
KLAC/LRCX/TXN: semicap and analog names all sub-2.5 flow — coordinated semi de-risking
AMD: 2.75 composite, flow 4.59 — puts dominating even as darkpool/blocks max out
C/WFC: money-center banks distributing, flow 3.83 and 1.90
RTX/GEV: defense/power names showing put premium skew
narrative.rotation_signal: Rotation OUT of semis (NVDA, AMD, KLAC, LRCX, TXN) and money-center banks (C, WFC) INTO pharma (ABBV, LLY, MRK), energy majors (XOM, CVX), and mega-cap platform tech ex-semis (GOOG/GOOGL, AMZN, AAPL, ORCL, NFLX). Institutions appear to be trimming AI-hardware beta while adding defensive cash-flow names and software/platform exposure.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: NVDA is the key divergence — dark pool and block magnitude score 10.0/10.0 (heavy institutional activity) but flow at 1.43 indicates that activity is defensive/put-hedged, not accumulation. AMD shows the same signature. If broader Tech/Semis industry layer reads bullish, this Top 50 flow disagrees. Conversely ABBV/MRK/LLY strength may run hotter than a neutral Healthcare industry read.
